notes.title: 🛑 New Demo v1.0 Live Now 🛑
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341531/331fea93c34ad3f93cdde5c26a5bff3f0da91ec9.png[/img]

I am so happy to announce that new demo is NOW LIVE on Steam!
Also, I would love to hear your feedback that you can always share in ⁠our Discord Server.! 

Here's the list of changes I made, that I remember on top of my head right now :
[list]
[*] Tutorials
[*] New UI
[*] Improved NPC Dialogs and interactions
[*] Farm Overhaul
[*] Increased the overall beauty
[*] Added Axe, Sickle and Pickaxe for resource gathering
[*] Fixed a LOT OF BUGS! 🙈
[*] 
[/list]

Happy Farming! 🧑‍🌾
